correctness.rationale: The published monomial normal form yields independent coordinate cycles. An internal cycle of length \(\ell\) and drift \(V\) has \(\gcd(N,V)\) finite-volume index cycles of length \(\ell N/\gcd(N,V)\). Its weighted return automorphism is conjugate to \(H^{N/g}\), where \(g=\gcd(N,V)\). Iteration by \(t\) has \(\gcd(t,L)\) subcycles with monodromy \(H^{(N/g)(t/\gcd(t,L))}\); independent fixed-element choices give the product formula. Möbius inversion gives all primitive cycles. Equality of one-step fixed counts with the untwisted permutation is equivalent to trivial full-cycle holonomies; the converse is an explicit gauge. Infinite nonzero-drift orbits admit free gauges and a product full-shift conjugacy. A separately implemented \(A_5\) exact checker verified 1,320 parameter cases and 11 involution-parity cases. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The temporal orbit census for all periodic finite spatial approximations of this established nonabelian class is a natural exact dynamical invariant, distinguishing systems with the same infinite-system entropy and shift conjugacy. Finite-volume holonomy is a precise necessary-and-sufficient obstruction to conjugacy to the untwisted model, and the \(A_5\) outer-involution example exhibits a nontrivial odd/even phase difference (6 versus 60 fixed points) despite infinite full-shift conjugacy. This supplies an unbounded parameter classification and a structural finite/infinite boundary, not an arbitrary small table or routine parameter change.
